summary: Verified current US prices (fetched live this session, URLs included) across three hitting-mat tiers, putting/landing turf, battery power stations, and quiet gas inverter generators for a mobile golf sim rental business. Budget mats run $99.99-$349 (GoSports Elite line, SIGPRO hitting strips, Fiberbuilt Hourglass kit). Mid-tier Fiberbuilt Performance Turf tee boxes and SIGPRO Softy Lite run $399-$790. Premium SIGPRO Softy, TrueStrike, and Fiberbuilt Player Preferred run $999.99-$1,599. Landing/putting turf strips range $289.99 (small landing pad) to $1,000+ (full putting turf). For power: EcoFlow Delta 3 ($629, 1024Wh) and Jackery 2000 v2 ($899, 2042Wh) are the quiet/indoor-safe battery options, giving roughly 1.3-4 hours at a 400-800W simulator+blower draw depending on unit and load - fine for most indoor bookings but tight for long outdoor days. Honda EU2200i ($1,199 MSRP) and Harbor Freight's Predator 3500 ($749.97) are gas-only, outdoor-only, ~48-57dBA quiet-class generators with 3-11 hour tank runtimes, better suited to all-day outdoor events where CO risk and noise rules don't apply. EcoFlow Delta 2 appears discontinued on EcoFlow's own site (redirects to Delta 3) so no live price could be verified for it; Delta 3 is the current equivalent-capacity replacement.
